# Independent oracle fixtures

Generated by `make_fixtures.py` (stdlib Python, deterministic; independent of the Go
fixture builder). `self_check.py` is a second, independent decryptor used to
validate them. Regenerate: `python3 -I make_fixtures.py` (writes next to itself).

| dir | content |
|---|---|
| known_key | RC4 key 1.1.26100.4, db + WAL (4 commits, page-1 frame in commit 4) |
| plain | same data, codec disabled |
| corrupt_wal | known_key with a flipped byte in frame 10 (first frame of commit 4, a page-1 frame): only commits 1-3 apply |
| no_wal | known_key db only (checkpoint state) |
| random_key | random 256-byte key, ~1.2 MB, for keystream derivation |
| junk | 10000 random bytes |

`expected_rows.json`: {table: [rows by ID]}, blobs lowercase hex.
`hash_sources.json`: FileHashes ID -> hashed content (column SHA1 holds MD5, column MD5 holds SHA-1).

SHA-256 of the decrypted image (bytes 18/19 = 1):
- known_key / plain: 4eb4d9ed316c11a23f4fdd1026f13c3428b45c439aa5d9543448c219c26c4dec
- corrupt_wal: 29e0ec0861065ac7006e75e85dba47e64a491ba3c6d7f497185a545ed1cf5e24
- no_wal: 0cd0bb33ec2b56902d2012b731136d25247cded525e0f071530e4d79a1f12040
- random_key (true key): 6c29d42a11e9221fe3c1860adb5e505790975718f930e487221cde078cbf0c20

Note: free-space voting cannot recover every keystream offset (offsets ~8-23 and
~4042-4095 are never free on a populated db), so key derivation is best-effort.
